review.tagline: Agent skill that rebuilds an image's object as procedural Three.js code
review.summary: img2threejs is a skill for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode that takes one reference image and generates a TypeScript THREE.Group factory recreating the object from primitives, procedural shaders and generated geometry. It runs a staged pipeline from blockout to optimization, with vision review and Python gate scripts, and outputs pivots, sockets and colliders for animation. A CLI installs it into detected agent hosts.
review.audience: Three.js developers using coding agents to turn reference images into models
strengths: Output is code only: no mesh files or downloaded assets, so models are small and editable
Generated models include pivots, sockets and colliders for animation
Quality gates block generation until a detail inventory is complete
Live gallery with source for each demo model
weaknesses: Needs a host agent with vision (Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode); model cost is not stated
Single image cannot guarantee likeness; unseen areas are low-confidence
Several gallery demos are still marked placeholder rather than final
Requires Node.js 18+, Git and Python 3.10+; plugins need a separate CLI
needs: Needs Node.js >= 18, Git, Python >= 3.10, Three.js, Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode
Models: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes
